rounds.note_en: Exact official recipient Airspan Networks Inc, named in NTIA indexed official award list; issuer brand original announces exact USD42729740 award and identifies current Airspan Networks Holdings LLC in its About text. The separate USD85.4m reorganisation equity, 2021 PIPE and 2023 loan already exist. No speculative later grant modification or acquisition funding is added.
